title: Simultaneous internal pressure and external load

symbols.definition: Internal pressure in kg/cm² at failure when external load is simultaneously acting
Bursting strength of a pipe in kg/cm² when no external load is simultaneously acting
Three-edge-bearing load at failure in kg/linear metre when there is simultaneous action of internal pressure and
Three-edge-bearing load at failure in kg/linear metre when there is no internal pressure simultaneously acting.

applicability: Given bursting strength and three-edge strength of the pipe, the relation between internal pressure and external loads causing failure is computed by the printed formula.
notes: Transcriber note: the numerator visibly prints T(1-s²) and the denominator S. It has not been replaced with a dimensionally repaired or normalized interaction equation.
